import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react"; import { getBatteries, getBatteryStatus, getTelemetryHistory } from "./api"; import TelemetryChart from "./TelemetryChart"; function Dashboard() { const [status, setStatus] = useState({ health: "UNKNOWN", latest: null }); const [history, setHistory] = useState([]); const [batteries, setBatteries] = useState([]); const [selectedDeviceId, setSelectedDeviceId] = useState(""); useEffect(() => { let mounted = true; const loadData = async () => { const batteriesData = await getBatteries(200); const batteryItems = (batteriesData.items || []).slice(); const targetDeviceId = selectedDeviceId || batteryItems[0]?.device_id || ""; const [statusData, historyData] = await Promise.all([ getBatteryStatus(targetDeviceId), getTelemetryHistory(25, targetDeviceId), ]); if (!mounted) { return; } setStatus(statusData); setHistory((historyData.items || []).slice().reverse()); setBatteries(batteryItems); if (!selectedDeviceId && targetDeviceId) { setSelectedDeviceId(targetDeviceId); } }; loadData(); const timer = setInterval(loadData, 5000); return () => { mounted = false; clearInterval(timer); }; }, [selectedDeviceId]); const latest = status.latest; const chartSeries = useMemo(() => { const labels = history.map((item) => { const date = new Date(item.timestamp); return date.toLocaleTimeString(); }); return { labels, voltage: history.map((item) => item.pack_voltage), current: history.map((item) => item.pack_current), temperature: history.map((item) => item.temperature), }; }, [history]); const healthClass = `health-badge ${status.health.toLowerCase()}`; const selectedBattery = batteries.find((row) => row.device_id === selectedDeviceId) || null; const selectedCells = latest?.cell_voltages || []; return (

VoltWatch Simulator

{status.health}
Selected Battery: {selectedDeviceId || "None"}

Battery Details

{selectedBattery ? ( <>
Entity name {selectedBattery.device_id}
Health {selectedBattery.health}
packSoC {selectedBattery.soc.toFixed(1)}%
Error_Count {selectedBattery.alarm_count}
active {selectedBattery.active ? "true" : "false"}
lastActivityTime {new Date(selectedBattery.last_activity).toLocaleString()}
packVoltage {selectedBattery.pack_voltage.toFixed(2)} V
packCurrent {selectedBattery.pack_current.toFixed(2)} A
temperature {selectedBattery.temperature.toFixed(2)} C
cycleCount {selectedBattery.cycle_count}
cellMax {selectedBattery.cell_max.toFixed(3)} V
cellIRmax {selectedBattery.cell_imbalance.toFixed(3)} V

Cell Voltages (16 cells)

{selectedCells.map((value, idx) => (
C{idx + 1} {value.toFixed(3)} V
))}
) : (

Select a battery from the list to view details.

)}

SOC

{latest ? `${latest.soc.toFixed(1)}%` : "--"}

{latest ? `${latest.pack_voltage.toFixed(2)} V` : "--"}

{latest ? `${latest.temperature.toFixed(2)} C` : "--"}

{latest ? `${latest.pack_current.toFixed(2)} A` : "--"}

Click a battery row to load detailed telemetry for that battery.

Entity Name packSoC Error_Count active cellIRmax lastActivityTime packVoltage packCurrent cycleCount health
{row.device_id} {row.soc.toFixed(1)} {row.alarm_count} {row.active ? "true" : "false"} {row.cell_imbalance.toFixed(3)} {new Date(row.last_activity).toLocaleString()} {row.pack_voltage.toFixed(2)} V {row.pack_current.toFixed(2)} A {row.cycle_count} {row.health}

Latest Telemetry Records ({selectedDeviceId || "All"})

{new Date(row.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString()} {row.pack_voltage.toFixed(2)} {row.pack_current.toFixed(2)} {row.soc.toFixed(1)} {row.temperature.toFixed(2)} {row.cycle_count} {row.alarms.length ? row.alarms.join(", ") : "NONE"}
); } export default Dashboard;
